name: workbench
description: Workbench control pane for an orchestrator session: workers, PRs and CI, what waits on the owner, what Claude left undone, context, cache, accounts and handover. Active only inside a workbench workspace.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at startup
autoOpen.description: Open the Workbench pane when a session starts in a workspace (it docks beside the chat in a wide terminal).

warnPercent.title: Context warning at (%)
warnPercent.description: Amber warning, one toast, and the /clear and /compact buttons when the context is this full.

urgentPercent.title: Context urgent at (%)
urgentPercent.description: Red alert card above the others at this fill.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long a cached prompt stays warm. Plans that use the 1 hour cache: pick 1h. An API key on the default cache: pick 5m. The reply data doesn't say which, so it is set here, never guessed.

undoneRetentionDays.title: Left undone: stale after (days)
undoneRetentionDays.description: Open left-undone items older than this are tagged stale, and a dropped item's words stay blocked this long. Nothing is deleted for age.

finishSends.title: Finish sends straight away
finishSends.description: Left undone: 'finish all' sends the request at once instead of filling the prompt box for you to read first.

accounts.title: Known accounts (label=folder)
accounts.description: Claude config folders to read usage from, as label=folder separated by commas, e.g. main=~/.claude, work=~/.claude/accounts/work. The mod learns each one's email from the claude binary; it never opens a login file and keys accounts on email, not the label.

accountNotes.title: Account notes (label=note)
accountNotes.description: Shown for an account until a usage reading replaces it, e.g. work=out of credits 4 Nov.

usageProbeMinutes.title: Read other accounts every (minutes)
usageProbeMinutes.description: How often the claude binary is asked for another account's usage (no model call). Only while the pane is on screen or a warning is live.

usageWarnPercent.title: Account warning at (%)
usageWarnPercent.description: Amber at this fill of the 5-hour window.

weekWarnPercent.title: Week warning at (%)
weekWarnPercent.description: Amber toast at this fill of the weekly window.

usageUrgentPercent.title: Account urgent at (%)
usageUrgentPercent.description: Red at this fill of either window.

autoMovePct.title: Automatic move at (%)
autoMovePct.description: When this session's account reaches this fill on the 5-hour or weekly meter and nothing is at risk, the conversation moves to another account on its own. 0 turns it off. Values between 1 and 49 count as 50.

briefFiles.title: Handover brief: files to read first
briefFiles.description: Relative paths the brief points to (pointers, never contents), separated by commas. Nothing under data/, no env files.

handoverClear.title: Handover runs /clear itself
handoverClear.description: Off: a queued handover puts /clear in the prompt box for you to press Enter on, then the brief. On: the clear runs when the turn ends. Running a command this way is unverified in a live session, so it stays off until you turn it on.

connectorProbe.title: Connector check after a swap (server|tool)
connectorProbe.description: One harmless read-only call to check a claude.ai connector survived a swap, as server|tool. Empty: off.
